what_it_solves: Shopifyブランド向けのコレクション並べ替え、マーケット別 merchandising、商品発見のA/Bテスト。公式サイトで確認。
subject: Japan customer development for Kimonix
body:
Hi Kimonix team,

I’m Kazuma Tamura, Founder & CEO of A-one road in Japan.

I noticed that Kimonix combines Shopify collection sorting with market-specific merchandising. I’d like to explore whether Japanese fashion brands could be a useful customer segment for you.

We can help identify prospective customers, approach local partners, and conduct Japanese-language customer discovery to test that opportunity.

Is Japan part of your current expansion plans? If so, would you be open to a 20-minute conversation next week?
https://calendar.app.google/9ZXzJVCiK36rF56Q6

If this is not relevant, let me know and I won’t follow up.

Best,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO | A-one road

message_review.reason: User requested human review before sending; monetary amounts and budget comparisons removed.
